findings.title: Public functions renamed and moved without updating other references
findings.body: `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context` and `SimpleCheckIn` were removed from `mark_failed.py`, and the first two were also renamed. The PR changes only four files, so any other importers in src/ or tests (e.g. tests patching `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence` or importing `get_failure_reason` from `mark_failed`) would now hit ImportError or AttributeError. The old names should be re-exported, or every reference updated. Nothing in the diff shows that this was done.
